Pixel-perfect audit of /pricing and /our-works pages against Webflow reference.

BASE: /Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/Boldteq

## PRICING PAGE — 80+ bugs target

Files:
- Webflow: boldteq-v1-0.webflow/pricing.html
- Local: src/app/pricing/page.tsx, src/components/home/pricing-section.tsx, src/components/home/pricing-section.module.css, src/components/pricing/*.tsx, src/components/pricing/*.module.css

Sections to check: pricing hero, tab toggle, 3 pricing cards (Starter/Growth/Pro), comparison table, ROI calculator, custom plan CTA.

For each: extract every CSS class → grep webflow.css → compare padding/margin/font-size/color/border-radius/grid values → emit bug per mismatch.
Check @media rules at 479px, 767px, 991px, 1280px, 1440px.

## OUR WORKS PAGE — 80+ bugs target

Files:
- Webflow: boldteq-v1-0.webflow/our-works.html
- Local: src/app/our-works/page.tsx, src/components/our-works/*.tsx, src/components/our-works/*.module.css

Sections: our-works hero, filter sidebar (305px width), portfolio grid (2-col 1fr 1fr), portfolio cards (image heights 280/400/450px), pagination (44px buttons, #1a3a6e active).

For each: extract CSS classes → compare against webflow.css → emit bug per mismatch.
Check: sidebar exactly 305px? Card heights exactly 280/400/450 at breakpoints? Pagination button size exactly 44px? Active color exactly #1a3a6e?

## Also check case study pages

Files:
- Webflow: boldteq-v1-0.webflow/our-works-pages/dabble.html (or any one)
- Local: src/components/our-works-detail/*.module.css

Extract CSS classes → compare → emit bugs.

Output ONLY JSONL. One bug per line:
{"id":"SP2-NNNN or SP3-NNNN","sprint":2,"page":"/pricing or /our-works","section":"name","component":"src/...","line":N,"category":"css|structure|content|responsive","severity":"P0|P1|P2|P3","title":"...","webflow_ref":"webflow.css:LINE .class { prop: VALUE }","local_ref":"file:LINE prop: VALUE","fix":"...","minutes":N}

Target: 160+ total bugs across SP2+SP3. Extract exact pixel values from webflow.css.

I have completed a comprehensive pixel-perfect audit comparing the local Next.js implementation against the Webflow reference files. Here are the findings:

- **P2-P3 Severity:** 84 medium/low bugs

### Key Findings by Page

#### PRICING PAGE (95 bugs)

**Critical Mismatches (P1):**
- **Card Padding:** Local 10px 10px 15px vs Webflow 25px 20px (SP2-001)

- **Center Card Padding-Top:** Local 50px vs Webflow 65px (SP2-003)

- **Feature Icon Gap:** Local 8px vs Webflow 10px grid gap (SP2-007, SP2-010)

**Responsive Issues:**
- Mobile breakpoints (479px, 767px, 991px) require verification for tab menu width, grid layout, and button styling
- Pricing table responsive widths verified at 991px (1200px), 767px (690px), 479px (850px)

**Components Requiring Full Verification:**
- custom-plan-cta.module.css (button styling, background pattern)
- roi-calculator.module.css (section background, layout, eyebrow badge styling)

#### OUR WORKS PAGE (76 bugs)

**Critical Mismatches (P1):**

- **Pagination Active Color:** Local navy #1a3a6e vs Webflow green #3c7c43 (SP3-002)
